packageRules.description: Group in-SDK (patch/minor) Expo package updates into one MR.
The jest major must stay on the version jest-expo supports (its internals are pinned to Jest 29).
TypeScript 7 ships no JavaScript API, which ts-loader needs, and Docusaurus's base tsconfig still sets baseUrl, which 7 rejects. Stay on 6 until both support 7.
The Babel major is dictated by the Expo SDK: babel-preset-expo and the React Native preset are Babel 7 and refuse to load under core 8.
Generated by ubrn from its template; `ubrn build android` rewrites it, so any bump here is reverted at the next regeneration.
Expo major versions track the Expo SDK; SDK upgrades go through `npx expo install --fix`, not Renovate.
React versions are dictated by the Expo SDK.
React Native versions are dictated by the Expo SDK.
@types/react-native-web 0.19.3 stopped augmenting react-native's types (it targets React Native 0.87), which the app relies on. Hold until the Expo SDK moves to 0.87.
Group community react-native module updates into one MR.
Third-party packages whose versions the Expo SDK pins (see expo/bundledNativeModules.json); only allow patch updates.
